renderedScreenshot.reviewBoundary: The full-page capture was made after actual homepage-to-About navigation and an observed immediate return to scroll position zero; only its hash and measured observations are retained in public Git.

followUp.method: The original full matrix retained one unloaded lazy image at 768px after a smooth-scroll traversal. Follow-up measurement verified all nine homepage images loaded. One final affected-row run traversed in 500px instant steps with 800ms and network-idle waits, reran the unchanged WCAG rules, captured every failed request with complete headers, and verified each corresponding real HTML destination in a separate fresh browser context.

requestClassification.description: Only same-origin non-navigation GET fetch requests with net::ERR_ABORTED, a nonempty _rsc parameter, RSC:1 and Next-Router-Prefetch:1 headers, and the matching non-redirect HTML200 destination are classified separately. Every other request failure remains a gate failure.
requestClassification.causeBoundary: The cause of the aborts is unproven. The installed Next.js scheduler says it does not abort in-progress requests; no intentional scheduler cancellation is claimed.

rawEvidence.scope: Full request headers, request/response events, CDP request initiators and cancellation events, real HTML destination checks, image observations, unchanged Axe rule output, and the preceding failed row are retained outside public Git.

priorFollowUps.interpretation: Observed ERR_ABORTED on _rsc URLs during this earlier traversal. Those records lack request headers, so their prefetch classification and the cause of cancellation remain unproven; they are preserved as historical observations rather than retroactively exempted.
